item.title: Soma 1.0 (900)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (900)

  • New Decks space (Mac only): Soma finds the decks you have open in PowerPoint, Safari and Chrome and keeps a list of them. Each deck is a card showing the app’s icon (or, for a local file, its first slide), the slide count and when it was last open.
  • Organise decks into sets, star favourites, tag them, link them to projects and tasks, and set a reminder to revisit one. If you used Slider, you can bring its library across.
  • Soma asks for permission to use PowerPoint, Safari and Chrome the first time the Decks space needs them.
  • People & Teams: the search box is now at the top of the sidebar. It narrows the sidebar and the page together, in every list: Everyone, Groups, Hierarchy, a team or a function.
  • A person’s page now opens with their details in a card: picture, role, team, function, email (with a copy button) and notes.
  • Hierarchy: pick someone in the sidebar, or search down to one person, and the chart jumps straight to them with a quicker, livelier arrival.
  • The “Downloading from iCloud” banner is gone on the Mac. Instead, a small cloud after About Soma turns blue when idle, green while syncing and red if a sync fails. Click it for the Sync Log.
  • Inbox is now My Inbox. Tasks can also be grouped by due date or by date added in a single list.
  • The Settings window is wide enough to show every tab, and the note widget refreshes when Soma starts, with up and down buttons for long notes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
